_doc: Paraphrase set P (E5_DESIGN.md section 2, eval 5). Hand-written, NOT by the data builder: 2 templates per PopQA relation, each holding {subj} exactly once, none equal to PopQA's own wording. Written and reviewed by Opus BEFORE training; then record sha256 of the canonical JSON of `templates` (ko/e5_paraphrase.py: templates_sha256) in the notebook and pass it as --templates-sha256. Relations: capital, capital of, director, screenwriter, author, genre, country, producer, composer, father, mother, occupation, sport, religion, place of birth, color. Example shape: "occupation": ["template one with {subj}", "template two with {subj}"]. Filled by Opus 2026-11-20 from memory of PopQA's wording, NOT yet compared with popqa_form on the real data: the builder only rejects an exact match.

capital: {subj} has which city as its capital?
capital of: Which place has {subj} as its capital?
{subj} serves as the capital of what?
author: Who wrote {subj}?
Name the author of {subj}.
occupation: What does {subj} do for a living?
sport: Name the sport {subj} takes part in.
